messages:
marta-cs: FYI — Cobalt Systems (enterprise) just flagged that their contract promo didn't apply to the latest dedicated-capacity invoice. They attached the PO note but discount never hit ledger. can someone triage?

zoe-support: can you paste the PO note + invoice id? I can ping billing once we have details.

marta-cs: PO note snippet: ```PO# 54321
Company: Cobalt Systems
Notes: Redwood Promo: ENT-50K - apply to first year
```
Invoice: INV-2024-334, customer id CS-99876. pinging @devon-sales who handled the deal.

devon-sales: saw this — sales added PROMO-ENT-2024-50K on contract. expectation was auto-apply when PO note includes the promo token. customer insists they included it exactly like above.

sara-billing: I ran the matcher against the invoice/PO notes. our promo parser didn't pick it up. looks like the matcher expects `redwoodpromo:<code>` (no space, lowercase) so `Redwood Promo: ENT-50K` fails case/whitespace rules.

marta-cs: wow 😬 okay. customer is upset. they want the credit applied now and a permanent fix so future POs aren't brittle.

aj-engineering: this matches a known parser fragility — regex we shipped is `^redwoodpromo:(\S+)$` and is case-sensitive. I can open a bug and schedule a fix to accept common variants (case-insensitive, allow a space, tolerate `promo` vs `promo:`). ETA for patch: early next week.

tom-legal: confirm the contract clause — sales captured $25,000 credit for year-one usage under promo PROMO-ENT-2024-50K. legal OK for manual ledger adjustment to honor the contract.

sara-billing: can do manual credit once we have approval. @tom-legal approving now — thanks. i'll apply a one-time credit of $25,000 to CS-99876 and update invoice INV-2024-334 notes.

devon-sales: please add an internal note tying the manual credit to the promo code and contract (so audits match). tag revenue-ops for reconciliation.

sara-billing: done — ledger entry LED-3421 created, applied $25,000 manual credit to INV-2024-334, reconciliation ticket TKT-7890 created, and customer notified by support with cc to sales. message sent: "We've applied the agreed contract credit; ledger entry LED-3421. Let us know if you see anything else."

marta-cs: thanks everyone. can we also add a runbook step for sales to standardize PO note formatting, and a check in the billing pipeline to surface unmatched contract promos?

aj-engineering: will add a parser fix (case-insensitive + optional space), unit tests, and an alert when a contract has a promo token but no matching ledger entry after invoice generation. i'll link the PR and bug: BUG-3124.

incident-bot: Created issue BUG-3124: promo-parser: support flexible PO note formats (assigned to aj-engineering).

zoe-support: closing the loop with customer: they acknowledged receipt and asked for confirmation once the parser fix is live. i told them manual credit applied and fix ETA next week.

marta-cs: perfect. follow-up action items: 1) billing manual ledger note (complete) 2) engineering PR + tests (aj) 3) sales ops runbook update (devon) 4) add alert to billing pipeline (aj/sara). i'll track this in our weekly ops sync. :thumbsup:
